exceptions.mitigation: The package is build tooling only. PR builds use ephemeral hosted runners with read-only tokens, no secrets, and no persisted checkout credentials. Never move these builds to privileged runners; remove the exception when Metro publishes a patched path.
exceptions.reason: React Native 0.86.2 pins Metro 0.84.4, which pins image-size 1.2.1. No patched image-size release exists; remove this exception when Metro provides one.

observations.mitigation: Do not force uuid across a major boundary. Monitor xcode for a compatible update and retain the install-time execution controls.
observations.reason: The vulnerable buffer-writing forms of uuid v3, v5, and v6 are not reachable. xcode 3.0.1 imports only uuid.v4() without a caller-provided buffer.
